_comment: FX-PAGE-01: page_transaction + extract helpers. Extract/get_entity_details vectors EXECUTED against verbatim bodies (probe /tmp/fx_probe2.py). Task flow transcribed from bgtasks/page_transaction_task.py:21-142. PageLog columns from db/models/page.py:80-110.
backfill_skip_quirk_port_as_is: new mention with id IN old_ids is skipped ONLY when has_existing_logs is True (page_transaction_task.py:112). First-ever run (no logs) RE-INSERTS every mention id found in the new html — including ones that predate tracking. mentions WITHOUT any id are always skipped (no PageLog row can exist without transaction id).

mention-component.extract: {entity_name: m.entity_name, entity_type: None (ALWAYS None — the tag attr is read by extract_all_components but DISCARDED by the lambda), entity_identifier: m.entity_identifier}

deletes: deleted_transaction_ids = union over components of (old_ids - new_ids); PageLog.objects.filter(transaction__in=<set>).delete() — ONE global delete across components (a mention id reused as an image id would delete both; port as-is); skipped when the set is empty
does_not_exist: except Page.DoesNotExist: return (bare; no logging). Any OTHER exception -> log_exception + return.
extract_vectors_note: malformed html yields EMPTY (not an error): BeautifulSoup never raises here; the outer except covers only catastrophic failure. Per-tag entity dict carries RAW tag attrs (entity_type attr present); normalization happens in get_entity_details.
ged_note: get_entity_details takes the RAW attr dict ({id, src} / {id, entity_*}), NOT the normalized shape. Unknown component -> all-None (no raise).
inserts: PageLog.objects.bulk_create(new_transactions, batch_size=50, ignore_conflicts=True) — skipped when empty; unique(page, transaction) makes re-insert of a live id a SILENT no-op

own: transaction (UUID, default uuid4 — but the task ALWAYS passes the mention id STRING)

task_flow: old/new = extract_all_components(old/new html) — either may be None

per component: old_ids/new_ids = {m.id truthy only}; deleted += old - new; for each NEW entity: skip if no id OR (id in old_ids AND has_existing_logs); else PageLog(transaction=mention_id, page_id, entity_* from get_entity_details, workspace_id=page.workspace_id, created/updated=now)
